sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Jungle Bricks Breaker is its simple yet engaging gameplay. The game is played on a rectangular screen, with bricks of different colors and sizes scattered across it. Your goal is to break all the bricks by using the right combination of balls and paddles. You'll need to use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to guide a small paddle at the bottom of the screen. The paddle will bounce a ball back and forth across the screen, and you'll need to time your movements perfectly to hit the bricks. Each brick will break when hit by the ball, and as you progress through the levels, the bricks will become increasingly difficult to break.

   The game also features power-ups and obstacles that will challenge your skills and keep you on your toes. Power-ups such as extra balls, paddles, and magnets will give you an edge in breaking the bricks, while obstacles such as moving bricks, ice blocks, and explosive blocks will make it harder to achieve your goal. The game also features different types of bricks with varying point values, making it harder to decide which ones to break first.

   As you progress through the levels, the game will introduce new challenges and obstacles that will require you to adapt your strategy and improve your skills.
